verified_facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Boston's Seaport District.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the heart of the bustling Seaport District, Omni Boston Hotel at the Seaport is your gateway to the charming and the ever-evolving city.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is near South Station, the harbor and the Thomas Michael Menino Convention and Exhibition Center.
verified_facts.excerpt: conveniently located near South Station, the harbor, the Thomas Michael Menino Convention and Exhibition Center

verified_facts.text: The hotel is 2.8 miles, about 8 minutes, from Boston Logan International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our hotel is 2.8 miles (about 8 minutes) from the Boston Logan International Airport (BOS).

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits in the Seaport District near downtown, with unobstructed Boston Harbor waterfront views.
verified_facts.excerpt: located in the Seaport District neighborhood, near downtown, with unobstructed Boston Harbor waterfront views

verified_facts.text: The hotel's address is 450 Summer Street, Boston, Massachusetts 02210.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel's physical address is 450 Summer Street, Boston, Massachusetts 02210.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with city and harbor views.
verified_facts.excerpt: guest rooms boasting floor-to-ceiling windows of unrivaled city and harbor views

verified_facts.text: Artist Tower rooms are compact studio-layout rooms designed for the individual traveler.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimalist space with maximum style, this cozy studio layout guestroom was designed for the individual traveler.

verified_facts.text: Patron Tower rooms have a spacious floor plan with sweeping harbor or Seaport District views.
verified_facts.excerpt: These sophisticated and warm guestrooms offer a spacious floor plan and feature sweeping harbor or Seaport District views.

verified_facts.text: The suites have floor-to-ceiling windows looking out on Massachusetts Bay and the Seaport skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our spacious suites celebrate the views of the Massachusetts Bay and Seaport skyline with floor to ceiling windows.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a heated rooftop pool and hot tub on the fifth floor, both open year-round.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Omni Boston Hotel at the Seaport boasts a fifth-floor heated rooftop pool and hot tub, both open year-round.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop pool has views of the city skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel has a rooftop outdoor pool located on the fifth floor with views of the city skyline, adjacent to Lifted Pool Bar.

verified_facts.text: Pool availability depends on capacity limits, and the pool deck can close for private events.
verified_facts.excerpt: Availability is contingent on capacity limits and the pool deck is subject to closure for private events.

verified_facts.text: Breve Spa is the hotel's full-service spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Revitalize and recharge at our full-service spa in the heart of Boston’s innovative Seaport District.

verified_facts.text: Breve Spa offers retail, full body treatments, a sauna and a steam room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relaxation awaits at Breve Spa, from retail therapy and full body treatments to a sauna and steam room

verified_facts.text: The fitness center has 200 feet of continuous floor-to-ceiling windows that bring in natural light.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our fitness center also boasts 200 feet of continuous floor to ceiling windows providing vast amounts of natural light

verified_facts.text: Artist Tower guests can borrow fitness gear for free through a partnership with Boston-born apparel company NOBULL.
verified_facts.excerpt: partnered with Boston-born high-performance fitness apparel company NOBULL to offer our Artist Tower guests access to complimentary gear lending

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers rooftop fitness classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooftop fitness classes

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a sports bar with a VIP room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover a sophisticated sports bar with a VIP room

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an all-day restaurant serving Mediterranean fare.
verified_facts.excerpt: an on-site all-day dining restaurant offering Mediterranean fare
